name: Vaktarekullen - Flötemarksön

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 20 Vaktarekullen - Flötemarksön
keyFacts: Official stage identity is 20. Vaktarekullen-Flötemarksön.
Canonical direction is Vaktarekullen to Flötemarksön.
Official rounded distance is 12 km.
Official estimated time is 5 h.
Official difficulty is Blue / medium.
Surface is forest path and dirt/gravel road.
WST says the stage starts at the Vaktarekullen cottage/rest hut in Kynnefjäll.
WST says the stage ends at Flötemarksön, formerly Holmen, near a public road and a bridge with a few parking spaces.
WST says neither Vaktarekullen nor Flötemarksön is directly reachable by public transport.
WST notes a mid-stage old forest-fire area where larger trees are scarce and regrowth can make the route harder to see or pass.
caveats: Official body text also uses Vaktarkullen in places; use Vaktarekullen from title/API/Naturkartan/Munkedal.
Older Holmen-ending route descriptions and tracks are stale for current Stage 20.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland: Kynnefjäll
keyFacts: Kynnefjäll reserve consists of Kynnefjäll A, Kynnefjäll B Skogsallmänning and Kynnefjäll-Sätret.
Reserve area is 1882 ha, managed by Västkuststiftelsen, in Munkedal and Tanum municipalities.
Bohusleden crosses the reserve.
Most of the area is Natura 2000.

Restrictions include fire only at manager-designated places, no motor vehicles, boats/canoes only on designated waters, tents only at manager-designated places, no digging plants and no collecting mosses/lichens.
Kynnefjäll A has fishing restrictions in Stora Holmevatten.
Sensitive birdlife at Stora Holmevatten is explicitly flagged.
caveats: Rules vary by subarea; final normalization needs GIS overlay for Kynnefjäll A/B/Sätret.
